get.description: Requires any positive discord:* permission or superadmin. Retention is included only for evidence-view or evidence-retention principals. A missing row returns defaults at revision zero. No secrets are returned.

put.description: Requires discord:configure. Full settings snapshot and current revision required. Server identity cannot change after initial configuration. Reaction roles cannot overlap membership, default, exemption, recruiter, or active rank roles. Retention uses its dedicated endpoint.

patch.description: Requires discord:evidence_retention. Expected revision required. Increases extend existing active finite evidence; indefinite removes active expiry. Reductions affect future evidence only.

post.summary: Report bot health and applied configuration
post.description: Bot token only. Guild must match current configuration. Reports applied revision (not a future revision) and optionally refreshed role/channel metadata. Optional metadataObservedAt requires metadata and defaults to receipt time. Reject future observations over 60 seconds and older inventory overwrites. Diagnostics use bounded codes and counters; configRevision cannot be in the future. GET config exposes observation/report times and diagnostics. Fresh inventory validates configured IDs and manageability; stale inventory does not block offline edits.

get.description: Requires a Discord permission. Returns commands whose action permission is granted (announcement history also requires orbat:edit), newest first; payloads and claim tokens are excluded.

post.summary: Queue a menu, welcome test, or synchronization action
post.description: Requires discord:configure. requestKey deduplicates identical actions. menu.publish requires an existing menuId; other payloads must be empty. Announcement and timeout actions use dedicated endpoints.

Requires discord:retry plus original action permissions (and orbat:edit for announcements). Only failed actions can retry; a failed announcement superseded by a newer noncancelled announcement is rejected. Advances generation and clears the prior claim. This does not itself perform any Discord action.

post.summary: Claim the next pending Discord command
post.description: Bot token only. Claims oldest pending action or expired lease for five minutes. Revalidates original requester permissions; revoked commands are cancelled. Returns null when no claim is available. Reconcile ambiguous effects before repeating after lease expiry.

Bot token only. Requires matching bot identity, claimToken and generation; stale/expired claims fail. Successful announcement completion requires actual messageId and matching channelId. Only confirmed timeout release marks the case released. Repeated terminal acknowledgement is accepted only when success, full result and error code match. Successful menu.publish completion also requires actual messageId and the current configured channelId; a removed menu or changed channel conflicts. Accepted completions store durable menu/channel references, retaining references in other channels and preventing an older command from replacing a newer reference.

get.description: Requires discord:announce and orbat:edit. Returns stored announcement, relevant public configuration and last ten commands. Missing announcement is null; missing ORBAT is 404.

post.summary: Queue mission publication, refresh or explicit reping
post.description: Requires discord:announce and orbat:edit. Stable requestKey deduplicates submission. Existing channel is fixed; at most one active announcement action per ORBAT. Publish requires no confirmed message; refresh/reping require confirmation. Refresh must never repeat mentions. Repost requires a previously reported missing message and mention none. Refresh/re-ping cannot recover a missing message.

mention.description: none, everyone (when enabled), or an allowed role snowflake

get.description: Requires discord:moderation_view, discord:timeout_release, or discord:evidence_view. Newest-first paging. Summaries contain no evidence content.

post.summary: Record and classify a honeypot trigger
post.description: Bot token only. triggerId deduplicates reports. Current configuration revision and matching enabled guild required; website classifies roles as exempt, timeout, or ban. Timeout expiry is calculated from server time and configured duration. No Discord punishment is performed by this HTTP request.

patch.description: Bot token only. Cannot punish an exempt or released case, or regress an applied case to failed. Applied timeouts require appliedAt and timeoutUntil, validating the configured minimum duration from actual execution. Cleanup contains counts and up to 500 per-message status/error records, never message content. Cleanup-only reports (without status, appliedAt or timeoutUntil) are accepted even after early release and cannot change punishment state. Empty updates are rejected; punishment timestamps require status. Cleanup-only updates omit status and cannot supply punishment timestamps; they remain valid after timeout release without changing releasedAt, timeoutUntil or status.

appliedAt.description: Required for applied timeout; must be at or after trigger and not in the future.

timeoutUntil.description: Required for applied timeout; at least configured duration (minimum 24h) from appliedAt.

get.description: Requires moderation-view, timeout-release, or evidence-view. No evidence content returned.

post.description: Requires discord:timeout_release. Queues a deduplicated release for an unexpired timeout. Website marks release only after executor acknowledgement. No extra moderation-view permission required.

reason.description: Optional nonblank reason retained with the release command.

get.description: Requires discord:evidence_view and audits access. Includes captured attachment bytes. state=active (default) or deleted (within recovery window); purged and expired-recovery records are not returned. Responses are private/no-store.

post.summary: Capture immutable moderation evidence and files
post.description: Bot token only. Maximum request 12,000,000 bytes; up to 10 attachments and 8 MiB decoded attachment total. Author must be case member and sentAt in the 30 minutes ending at trigger. Duplicate case/message upload returns existing receipt only if content matches; deleted evidence cannot be resurrected by upload. A 413 must be reported as capture failure, not permission to delete uncaptured source files.

patch.summary: Delete, restore or retain evidence indefinitely
patch.description: Requires discord:evidence_view plus action grant: discord:evidence_delete, discord:evidence_restore, or discord:evidence_retention. Expected version required. Deletion allows exactly seven days recovery, including indefinite items. Restore preserves indefinite state; finite restoration grants at least seven additional active days. Deleted evidence must be restored before indefinite marking. No immediate purge route.

post.description: Bot token only. Matching claim, generation and bot identity must still own an unexpired running lease. Renews for five minutes. Renew during long retry delays; an expired lease requires reconciliation and reclaim.

get.description: Bot token only. Ascending account cursor pagination. Optional exact discordId filter. Each item has id (auth-account ID used by the cursor), userId (website user ID), discordId, username, nameRevision, and userRank. No email or unrelated account data.

patch.description: Bot token only. Requires enabled synchronization and no member exclusion. Website validation requires trimmed name 1–50 characters. nameRevision provides optimistic concurrency. Bot strips only managed prefixes and supplies optional moderator actorDiscordId; clearing nickname restores existing website name rather than submitting an empty name.

get.description: Bot token only. Runs canonical eligibility as the linked member without staff grants; interaction must use author Discord ID. Signup feature must be enabled. No arbitrary website-user override.

post.description: Bot token only. Resolves the author’s linked account and current signup for this ORBAT. Uses member permissions, canonical transactional eligibility/capacity/deadline rules, and no administrative prerequisite override. Feature must be enabled. PATCH/DELETE require stable signupId for receipt replay; the server verifies member and ORBAT ownership. No arbitrary user IDs accepted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable interaction receipt key; one key per intended mutation.

patch.description: Bot token only. Resolves the author’s linked account and current signup for this ORBAT. Uses member permissions, canonical transactional eligibility/capacity/deadline rules, and no administrative prerequisite override. Feature must be enabled. PATCH/DELETE require stable signupId for receipt replay; the server verifies member and ORBAT ownership. No arbitrary user IDs accepted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable interaction receipt key; one key per intended mutation.

delete.description: Bot token only. Resolves the author’s linked account and current signup for this ORBAT. Uses member permissions, canonical transactional eligibility/capacity/deadline rules, and no administrative prerequisite override. Feature must be enabled. PATCH/DELETE require stable signupId for receipt replay; the server verifies member and ORBAT ownership. No arbitrary user IDs accepted.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Stable interaction receipt key; one key per intended mutation.

get.description: Bot token only. Uses linked member identity and canonical website rules without staff deadline exceptions. Feature must be enabled. Absence does not implicitly cancel a signup.

patch.description: Bot token only. Uses linked member identity and canonical website rules without staff deadline exceptions. Feature must be enabled. Absence does not implicitly cancel a signup.

delete.description: Bot token only. Uses linked member identity and canonical website rules without staff deadline exceptions. Feature must be enabled. Absence does not implicitly cancel a signup.

get.description: Bot token only. Ascending announcement-ID cursor pagination for restart reconciliation. Includes pending records with null messageId. Refetch all pages for a full sweep; the cursor is not an update feed. Responses are private/no-store.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; values above 100 are capped at 100.

get.description: Requires discord:configure or superadmin. Ascending record-ID cursor pagination. References survive menu removal and channel changes; distinct channels retain distinct records. A full sweep is needed to observe updates to existing records. Responses are private/no-store.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; values above 100 are capped at 100.

get.description: Requires discord:view or discord:configure (or superadmin). Newest first using descending record-ID cursor pagination. Optional exact kind/status filters. Reports contain bounded identifiers and outcome codes, not evidence or free-text errors. Responses are private/no-store and reads are audited.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; values above 100 are capped at 100.

post.description: Bot token only. Maximum request size 4096 bytes. eventId is immutable and globally unique: identical replays return the existing report (200), changed content conflicts (409). New reports require the configured guild and a known positive configuration revision; delayed older revisions are accepted. occurredAt may be at most 60 seconds ahead. Reports record outcomes only, never queue retries or prove a Discord side effect occurred. No evidence/message content or free-text error payloads.

attempts.description: At most three for join.roles; at most six otherwise.

errorCode.description: Required only for failed reports; forbidden otherwise. Bounded code, not free-text error.

get.description: Requires discord:configure. Newest first. Immutable behavior snapshots; retention remains separately restricted. Existing active configuration is backfilled at the next write.

post.description: Requires discord:retry and discord:configure. Only failed join.roles reports with a member are eligible. Uses current configured default roles; refuses any honeypot ban and duplicate pending retry. Queues join.retry; executor reconciles current state before retrying. Creating a honeypot ban cancels pending/running join.retry commands and invalidates their leases atomically.

get.description: Bot-only. Requires a confirmed published announcement, enabled announcements and no pending/running explicit announcement command. Current public roster projection and SHA256 content revision exclude personal notes. Fetch live image immediately before edit; disable mentions. Never automatically publish an unannounced ORBAT.

post.summary: Acknowledge automatic render or missing message
post.description: Bot-only. Exact target and current content revision required. Stale content returns409 and clears renderedRevision to force repair. Wrong message/channel conflicts without changes. Identical receipts preserve timestamps. A missing message requires an explicit staff repost; updated receipts cannot clear missing state.

get.description: Requires discord:configure; newest first. Optional requestKey identifies a queued preview.

post.description: Website administrator session with discord:configure only. apply_defaults uses current configured defaults; remove_menu_role requires roleId currently or historically in a menu. Protected roles are rejected. Creates a 15-minute revision-bound plan and bulk.preview command. Request key deduplicates.

get.summary: Read bulk preview and affected members
get.description: Requires discord:configure. Inspect immutable snapshot pages before confirming.

post.summary: Upload a reviewed bulk preview page
post.description: Bot-only live preview claim. Sequential pages 0–99, at most100 unique members each, no cross-page duplicates. Nonfinal pages cannot be empty. Final page seals preview and acknowledges preview command. Exact replay is idempotent.

Website administrator session with discord:configure. Requires complete nonempty unexpired preview and unchanged configuration. version is the reviewed version. Queues bulk.execute; exact request replay is idempotent.

post.summary: Fetch current authorized bulk execution targets
post.description: Bot-only live execution claim; rechecks requester permission, config revision, protected roles and expiry. Returns only reviewed IDs minus honeypot bans and already recorded outcomes. Every honeypot ban case blocks the member regardless of case status.

post.summary: Record outcomes for the reviewed member page
post.description: Bot-only live execution claim. Exactly one outcome per original preview member, including skipped banned members. failed requires bounded errorCode; other statuses forbid it. Immutable exact replay; report every page before completing execution. Exact receipt replay remains valid after execution completion when the claim token/generation still match.
